svg.title: Handling three and a half frames
svg.desc: The same four frames. Frames 1, 2, and 3 are handled in order from the buffer without reading again. The first 248 bytes of Frame 4 are saved. Read 2 returns the last 352 bytes of Frame 4, and 248 plus 352 makes the complete 600 byte Frame 4.
